title: Cancel Bag Out for Manual Bag Out to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process
summary: Use the manual bag out “cancel bag out” option to cancel exchange tasks that are not already in process.
when_to_use: When you are performing a manual bag out and need to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process (i.e., pending/queued for exchange but not currently in process).
not_for: Do not use “cancel bag out” to cancel exchange tasks that are already in process; those are expected to still finish.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the manual bag out “cancel bag out” action on the site AVEVA HMI and verify the resulting exchange-task state.
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA HMI (manual bag out popup / cancel bag out option)

system_preconditions: You are in the manual bag out context where the “cancel bag out” option is available.

visual_references.description: Training frame showing Overall System Bag Out Control and the manual bag out/cancel bag out concept (includes statement that cancel bag out cancels exchange tasks that are not in process).
Training frame explicitly stating: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancel bag out that will cancel any exchange task… So that is not in process.”

steps.title: Open the site AVEVA HMI manual bag out controls
steps.purpose: Access the manual bag out popup/controls that include the “cancel bag out” option.
steps.instruction: On the site AVEVA HMI, open the screen/popup that contains the manual bag out controls and the “cancel bag out” option.
steps.expected_result: The manual bag out popup/controls are visible and include a “cancel bag out” option.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the manual bag out popup/controls with the “cancel bag out” option available for selection.
steps.failure_condition: The manual bag out popup/controls are not available, or the “cancel bag out” option is not present.

actions.label: Open manual bag out popup
actions.exact_action: Open the site HMI screen that contains the manual bag out controls and the “cancel bag out” option (AVEVA HMI / Overall System bag-out related controls).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide text context: “Overall System Bag Out Control … In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancelled bag out. This will cancel any exchange chest that is not in process.”

steps.title: Confirm you are in the manual bag out context where “cancel bag out” is available
steps.purpose: Ensure the “cancel bag out” option applies to the manual bag out workflow.
steps.instruction: Verify that the currently displayed popup/context is the manual bag out popup where the “cancel bag out” option can be selected.
steps.expected_result: The “cancel bag out” option is selectable in the manual bag out context.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI is showing the manual bag out popup/options (not a different bag-out mode) and “cancel bag out” is available.
steps.failure_condition: You are not in the manual bag out context, or “cancel bag out” is not available/does not apply to the current workflow.

actions.label: Verify manual bag out context
actions.exact_action: Confirm you are in the manual bag out context where the “cancel bag out” option is available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR includes: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancel bag out that will cancel any exchange task… So that is not in process.”

steps.title: Select “cancel bag out” to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process
steps.purpose: Trigger the cancellation behavior for exchange tasks outside the in-process set.
steps.instruction: In the manual bag out popup, select “cancel bag out”.
steps.expected_result: The system cancels exchange tasks that are not in process (pending/queued for exchange no longer remain active/pending for exchange).
steps.healthy_condition: After selection, pending/queued exchange tasks that were not in process are no longer shown as active/pending for exchange.
steps.failure_condition: Pending/queued exchange tasks are not canceled, or cancellation appears to affect tasks that are already in process.

actions.label: Cancel bag out
actions.exact_action: Select “cancel bag out” to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the “cancel bag out” action does not cancel pending exchange tasks.
Stop and escalate if tasks appear to be canceled while they are already in process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text includes: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancel bag out that will cancel any exchange task… So that is not in process.”

steps.title: Verify cancellation effect on exchange tasks
steps.purpose: Confirm that only exchange tasks not in process were canceled.
steps.instruction: Check the live exchange-task state to confirm that exchange tasks that were not in process are no longer pending/queued for exchange.
steps.expected_result: Exchange tasks that were not in process are canceled (they no longer appear as pending/queued for exchange).
steps.healthy_condition: Only not-in-process exchange tasks disappear from pending/queued exchange state; in-process tasks continue to finish.
steps.failure_condition: Not-in-process exchange tasks remain pending/queued, or in-process tasks are canceled/removed.

actions.label: Verify exchange-task state
actions.exact_action: Verify the cancellation effect: exchange tasks that were not in process should be canceled (i.e., no longer appear as pending/queued for exchange).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if cancellation does not remove pending exchange tasks.
Stop and escalate if tasks appear to be canceled while they are already in process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Nearby text: “In the event of a manual bag out … cancel bag out … cancel any exchange … not in process.”

success_criteria: After selecting “cancel bag out” during manual bag out, exchange tasks that were not in process are no longer pending/queued for exchange.
Exchange tasks that are already in process are not canceled and continue to finish.
healthy_conditions: Pending/queued exchange tasks that were not in process are removed from the exchange pending/queued state.
In-process exchange tasks remain active and complete.
failure_conditions: Pending/queued exchange tasks that were not in process remain active/pending after “cancel bag out”.
Tasks that are already in process appear to be canceled/removed.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to FORTNA support if canceling does not remove pending exchange tasks or if behavior contradicts the “not in process” scope.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Slide text: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancel bag out that will cancel any exchange task that is not in process.”
